wireContract.anchorSyntax: Reuse existing sent anchor/range syntax and resolver, not a new substring or offset language. recordOwnership.claim: aboutAt must resolve to the same record as that claim.at.
recordOwnership.candidateStatement: aboutAt must resolve to the same record as statement.at, independently of the candidate object's optional at.
recordOwnership.match: aboutAt must resolve to the same record as match.at. It need not be within the same at interval: a record's own earlier condition header remains usable.
recordOwnership.role: roleAboutAt must resolve to a record actually named by that role's basis. Null role requires null roleAboutAt. One anchor cannot combine several source versions. A mixed-basis role must not present the one selected condition as applying to all records; use null when no single honest role condition exists and preserve distinctions in role/claims/citations.

wireContract.normalization: Resolve first, then take the exact raw passage with outer whitespace trim only, matching existing stored about presentation. Preserve internal spaces, line breaks, Markdown, case and characters. No concatenation, emphasis repair, summarization, metadata lookup, substring selection or truncation is used to fill about. Reject a blank resolved condition.
wireContract.boundsAndNull: After the declared outer trim, retain existing80 UTF-16 limits for role/claim/candidate condition and200 for match condition. A non-null anchor over its bound rejects the whole reply with its path and a condition-length rule; it is never silently shortened or changed to null. The prompt permits the model to choose null initially when no suitably short truthful raw condition exists, while retaining relevant named version/environment/observation distinctions in text and its raw evidence. Null is not permission to omit a material condition or claim completion; independent meaning acceptance still judges that.
wireContract.material: Condition anchors are evidence too. Retain their resolved ranges locally until material validation and reject any overlap with the reply's material ranges, for all four slots. Existing contradictions() currently enumerates basis/claim-at/role-replacement/relation/match-at/candidate-statement-at at map-reading.ts:421-427, so simply decoding and discarding aboutAt before that check would leave a hole.
wireContract.diagnostics: Map7 failures identify the precise aboutAt/roleAboutAt path and bounded rule/target such as reference, condition-source, condition-length or material-evidence. Report only the supplied bounded alias and/or record identity, not raw source contents or declaration text. Preserve syntax-versus-contract classification. Do not broaden old map6 diagnostics as a side project.

sourceDeclarationBoundary.existingData: PastedRecord.evidence contains user kind/name/version/origin; normal source citations already map back to the actual record ID and the source UI shows those declarations as user supplied, not app-executed verification.
sourceDeclarationBoundary.implementation: Do not add a model field for declared provenance. Do not place a declared source version in any normalized about value. Continue showing the declaration separately for each cited source, including when its bytes also occur in old pasted reports. Preserve actual raw report/check conditions through the new anchors. No formatted basis/note parsing is needed to recover declared authority.
sourceDeclarationBoundary.limit: A condition anchor proves location and ownership, not that the passage is semantically a condition for the asserted claim. Do not certify source version from code comments about a different dependency or Zephyr document. Semantic review remains necessary.
